_comment: Curated watchlist for the market-review check-ins (src/tools/market-review/).
`tickers` are underlyings reviewed every run, on top of whatever the account already holds
and whatever the day's market scan surfaced. `optionUnderlyings` is the subset whose option
chains get pulled — chain pulls are the expensive call, so this list is deliberately short.
`notes` explain why a name is here, and are printed in the report so the reason never gets lost.
Edit this file directly; nothing generates it.

notes.SPY: Primary 0DTE vehicle — daily expirations, deepest options liquidity.
notes.QQQ: Tech-beta read for the semiconductor holdings; not traded directly.
notes.NVDA: Largest single-name AI exposure in the account.
notes.MU: Largest position by value; earnings move the whole semi basket.
notes.AMD: Held; moves with NVDA but with a wider spread.
